SELECT 
    rc.loan_id,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM 
    risk_classification rc
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
ORDER BY 
   !rc.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    asset_resolution_event are ON ld.loan_id = are.loan_id
WHERE 
    are.event_type = 'WRITE_OFF'
    AND are.status = 'COMPLETED';

SELECT payment_id, business_date, amount
FROM payment_event
WHERE is_cash = 1 AND amount > 5000000
ORDER BY amount DESC;

SELECT 
    pp.party_id,
    pp.annual_income
FROM 
    person_profile pp
JOIN 
    party p ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'PERSON'
    AND pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY 
    pp.annual_income DESC;

SELECT card_id, issued_on, expires_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = '贷记卡'
ORDER BY issued_on ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    op.operating_status
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit sh_ou ON ou.region_code = sh_ou.region_code
WHERE 
    sh_ou.unit_name = '上海分行'
    AND p.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
ORDER BY 
    p.party_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM 
    organization_unit ou
JOIN 
    account a ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    account_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ic.sector_name_zh,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector ic ON op.industry_code = ic.sector_code
GROUP BY 
    ic.sector_code, ic.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    SUM(phs.carrying_amount) AS total_market_value
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY 
    total_market_value DESC
LIMIT !10;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS relation_count
FROM 
    party_relation pr
JOIN 
    party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN 
    account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    relation_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cs.net_capital,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    cs.net_capital DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(abs.balance_after) AS total_deposit_balance
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN 
    account_balance_snapshot abs ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
WHERE 
    a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_deposit_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days) AS avg_overdue_days
FROM 
    delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY 
    avg_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, 0)) AS exposure_amount,
    (SUM(COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, 0)) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) AS exposure_ratio
FROM 
    exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    )
    AND cs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM capital_snapshot cs2 
        WHERE cs2.institution_id = cs.institution_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
ORDER BY 
    exposure_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    isec.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS total_loan_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('次级', '可疑', '损失') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS npl_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('次级', '可疑', '损失') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS npl_ratio
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
LEFT JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id 
    AND rc.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM risk_classification 
        WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    isec.sector_code, isec.sector_name_zh
HAVING 
    COUNT(ld.loan![]() >= 20
ORDER BY 
    npl_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT risk_level, COUNT(*) AS product_count, AVG(management_fee_rate) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM wealth_product
GROUP BY risk_level
ORDER BY risk_level ASC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_balance
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN 
    party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE 
    gc.status = '有效'
    AND sa.status = '有效'
    AND (gc.effective_to IS NULL OR gc.effective_to >= date('now'))
    AND (sa.effective_to IS NULL OR sa.effective_to >= date('now'))
GROUP BY 
    g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    party_relation pr
JOIN 
    party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count,
    SUM(d.observed_value) AS total_observed_value
FROM 
    data_security_event_v3 d
JOIN 
    institution i ON d.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    d.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_observed_value DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
FROM 
    regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN 
    institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    (r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.in!institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    overdue_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM 
    capital_snapshot cs
JOIN 
    institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY 
    capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan!_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
    AND rc.grade_code IN (
        SELECT grade_code 
        FROM classification_grade 
        WHERE grade_name_zh IN ('正常', '关注')
    )
    AND rc.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(rc_inner.as_of_date)
        FROM risk_classification rc_inner
        WHERE rc_inner.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
ORDER BY 
    ds.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS insufficient_provision_loan_balance
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = lbs.as_of_date
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = lbs.as_of_date
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE 
    cg.is_nonperforming = 1
    AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > 100000000
ORDER BY 
    insufficient_provision_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    p.display_name AS payee_name,
    isec.sector_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
    AND isec.risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类')
ORDER BY 
    pi.instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN ind.sector_name_en IN ('Restricted', 'Exit') THEN pi.instruction_amount 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS non_compliant_amount,
    SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS total_instruction_amount,
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN ind.sector_name_en IN ('Restricted', 'Exit') THEN pi.instruction_amount 
            ELSE 0 
        END) * 1.0 / SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS ratio
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector ind ON ca.target_industry_code = ind.sector_code
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_id,
    ma.maturity_on AS asset_maturity_date,
    wp.actual_termination_on AS product_termination_date
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE 
    ma.maturity_on IS NOT NULL 
    AND wp.actual_termination_on IS NOT NULL
    AND ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY 
    ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS borrower_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    guarantee_count DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh AS payment_type_name_zh,
    pe.amount,
    ou.unit_name AS org_unit_name
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pe.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
    AND pe.amount > 5000000
    AND pe.status = 'CLEARED'
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    op_industry.sector_name_zh AS borrower_registered_industry,
    ca_industry.sector_name_zh AS agreement_target_industry,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector op_industry ON op.industry_code = op!_industry.sector_code
JOIN 
    industry_sector ca_industry ON ca.target_industry_code = ca_industry.sector_code
WHERE 
    ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
    AND ca.target_industry_code != op.industry_code
ORDER BY 
    ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    ah_from.party_id AS payer_party_id,
    ah_to.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account_holder ah_from ON pe.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id 
    AND ah_from.effective_to IS NULL
JOIN 
    account_holder ah_to ON pe.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id 
    AND ah_to.effective_to IS NULL
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON ah_from.party_id = pr.source_party_id 
    AND ah_to.party_id = pr.target_party_id
    AND pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
    AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
WHERE 
    pe.status = '已清算'
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(pe.amount) AS total_amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id OR pe.to_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1 
    AND pe.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY 
    total_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sm.staff_id,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN 
    account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON to_acc.account_id = ah.account_id 
    AND ah.effective_to IS NULL
JOIN 
    party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE 
    isec.risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类')
GROUP BY 
    sm.staff_id
ORDER BY 
    transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 1!0;

SELECT 
    cdd.record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    cdd.event_date,
    cdd.deadline_date,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(cdd.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_overdue
FROM 
    customer_due_diligence_event_v3 cdd
JOIN 
    institution i ON cdd.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cdd.event_date <= '2026-06-30'
    AND cdd.completion_date IS NULL
ORDER BY 
    days_overdue DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.status AS collateral_status,
    sa.status AS security_status
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN 
    collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'RELEASED'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    sa.security_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ca.agreement_id,
    sa.security_id,
    so.covered_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE 
    ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND (so.effective_to IS NULL OR so.effective_to > datetime('now'))
ORDER BY 
    so.covered_amount DESC;

WITH LoanBalances AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        l.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.institution_id 
            ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, l.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rank_in_institution
    FROM institution i
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown l ON ca.agreement_id = l.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = l.loan_id
    )
),
MaxLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        institution_name,
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        rank_in_institution
    FROM LoanBalances
    WHERE rank_in_institution = 1
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    rank_in_institution
FROM MaxLoans
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    sec.sector_name_zh AS industry_name_zh,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sec.sector_code ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS rank_in_industry
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector sec ON op.industry_code = sec.sector_code
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id)
ORDER BY 
    sec.sector_name_zh ASC,
    rank_in_industry ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    business_date,
    daily_count,
    daily_count - LAG(daily_count, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS count_change
FROM (
    SELECT 
        business_date,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_count
    FROM payment_event
    GROUP BY business_date
)
ORDER BY business_date ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    avg_bal.avg_principal_balance,
    (lbs.principal_balance - avg_bal.avg_principal_balance) AS excess_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            ca_inner.institution_id,
            AVG(lbs_inner.principal_balance) AS avg_principal_balance
        FROM 
            loan_drawdown ld_inner
        JOIN 
            loan_balance_snapshot lbs_inner ON ld_inner.loan_id = lbs_inner.loan_id
        JOIN 
            credit_agreement ca_inner ON ld_inner.agreement_id = ca_inner.agreement_id
        GROUP BY 
            ca_inner.institution_id
    ) avg_bal ON ca.institution_id = avg_bal.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.principal_balance > avg_bal.avg_principal_balance
ORDER BY 
    excess_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
LEFT JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING 
    COUNT(cl.collateral_id) = 0
ORDER BY 
    sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 31
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 91
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 181
        ELSE 361
    END AS interval_start,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM delinquency_snapshot
GROUP BY interval_start
ORDER BY interval_start ASC;

SELECT 
    collateral_id,
    valued_on,
    COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM 
    collateral_valuation
GROUP BY 
    collateral_id, 
    valued_on
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY 
    collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance,
    (SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / COUNT(ld.loan_id)) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
    AND lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(lbs2.as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id
ORDER BY 
    avg_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    ou.unit_name AS org_unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count
FROM 
    organization_unit ou
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON ou.org_unit_id = sm.home_org_unit_id
JOIN 
    payment_event pe ON sm.staff_id = pe.operator_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 1!10;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    AVG(pp.annual_income) AS avg_annual_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS high_income_ratio
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'PERSON'
GROUP BY 
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 
    p.customer_segment ASC;

WITH transaction_with_institution AS (
    SELECT 
        pe.payment_id,
        pe.amount,
        pe.currency_code,
        COALESCE(acc_from.institution_id, acc_to.institution_id) AS institution_id,
        ah_from.party_id AS from_holder_party_id,
        ah_to.party_id AS to_holder_party_id
    FROM payment_event pe
    LEFT JOIN account acc_from ON pe.from_account_id = acc_from.account_id
    LEFT JOIN account acc_to ON pe.to_account_id = acc_to.account_id
    LEFT JOIN account_holder ah_from ON pe.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id 
        AND ah_from.effective_to IS NULL 
        AND ah_from.holder_role = 'OWNER'
    LEFT JOIN account_holder ah_to ON pe.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id 
        AND ah_to.effective_to IS NULL 
        AND ah!_to.holder_role = 'OWNER'
    WHERE pe.status = 'SUCCESS'
),
related_parties AS (
    SELECT 
        twi.payment_id,
        twi.amount,
        twi.institution_id,
        twi.from_holder_party_id,
        twi.to_holder_party_id
    FROM transaction_with_institution twi
    JOIN party_relation pr ON twi.from_holder_party_id = pr.source_party_id 
        AND twi.to_holder_party_id = pr.target_party_id
        AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
        AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
),
institution_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM transaction_with_institution
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
related_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        SUM(amount) AS related_amount
    FROM related_parties
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(rt.related_amount, 0.0) AS related_transaction_amount,
    COALESCE(it.total_amount, 0.0) AS total_transaction_amount,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(it.total_amount, 0.0) = 0 THEN 0.0
        ELSE COALESCE(rt.related_amount, 0.0) * 1.0 / it.total_amount
    END AS ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN related_totals rt ON i.institution_id = rt.institution_id
LEFT JOIN institution_totals it ON i.institution_id = it.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pc.card_type = 'CREDIT_CARD' THEN pc.card_id END) AS credit_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN td.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN td.account_id END) AS term_deposit_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN 
    account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id AND pc.card_type = 'CREDIT_CARD'
LEFT JOIN 
    term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pc.card_type = 'CREDIT_CARD' THEN pc.card_id END) > 0
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN td.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN td.account_id END) > 0
ORDER BY 
    term_deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    AVG(JULIANDAY('2026-06-30') - JULIANDAY(ld.disbursed_on)) AS avg_loan_age_days
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE 
    ld.disbursed_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    avg_loan_age_days DESC;

SELECT 
    loan_id, 
    principal_balance, 
    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
FROM 
    loan_balance_snapshot
WHERE 
    as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
ORDER BY 
    quartile_group ASC, 
    principal_balance DESC, 
    loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH industry_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.industry_code,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
    GROUP BY ca.industry_code
),
industry_with_name AS (
    SELECT 
        ilb.industry_code,
        isec.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
        ilb.total_balance
    FROM industry_loan_balance ilb
    JOIN industry_sector isec ON ilb.industry_code = isec.sector_code
),
cumulative_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        industry_name,
        total_balance,
        SUM(total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY total_balance DESC) AS running_sum,
        SUM(total_balance) OVER () AS grand_total
    FROM industry_with_name
),
final_result AS (
    SELECT 
        industry_name,
        total_balance,
        ROUND(running_sum * 1.0 / grand_total, 6) AS cumulative_ratio
    FROM cumulative_calc
)
SELECT 
    industry_name,
    total_balance,
    cumulative_ratio
FROM final_result
WHERE cumulative_ratio <= 0.8
ORDER BY cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    i.institution_name AS institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS outstanding_loan_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ld.status != 'CLOSED'
    AND ld.closed_on IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, i.institution_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    outstanding_loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    ca.collateral_id,
    cv.valuation_amount
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN 
    collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN 
    collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE 
    cv.valuation_amount = (
        SELECT MAX(cv_inner.valuation_amount)
        FROM collateral_valuation cv_inner
        WHERE cv_inner.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
    )
    AND cv.valuation_amount > (so.covered_amount * 2.0)
ORDER BY 
    (cv.valuation_amount - so.covered_amount) DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) AS institution_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN 
    account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND a.institution_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) > 2
ORDER BY 
    institution_count DESC;

SELECT from_account_id AS account_id, business_date AS transaction_date, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM payment_event
WHERE from_account_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY from_account_id, business_date
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(re.gross_exposure, 0)) AS total_loan_balance
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    exposure_group eg ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
LEFT JOIN 
    risk_exposure re ON egm.party_id = re.obligor_party_id 
                     AND eg.institution_id = re.institution_id
                     AND re.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    COUNT(*) AS guarantee_contract_count,
    SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment g
JOIN 
    party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY 
    g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 1 
    AND SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) > 300000000.0
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE 
    ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND lbs.overdue_since IS NOT NULL
    AND julianday('202!6-06-30') - julianday(lbs.overdue_since) >= 90
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    pi.instruction_amount,
    pp.display_name AS payee_name
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    payment_instruction pi ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ld.disbursement_account_id IS NOT NULL AND p.party_id = (
        SELECT ah.party_id 
        FROM account_holder ah 
        WHERE ah.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id 
        AND ah.holder_role = 'BORROWER'
        LIMIT 1
    )
JOIN 
    party pp ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
    AND pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY 
    pi.instruction_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON ca.facility_id = cf.facility_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
    AND p.status = 'FROZEN'
    AND cf.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    lpc.product_name_zh,
    isec.sector_name_zh,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_product_catalog lpc ON ca.product_family = lpc.product_code
JOIN 
    industry_sector isec ON ca.target_industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE 
    ld.status = '正常'
    AND lpc.is_working_capital = 1
    AND isec.risk_category = '退出类'
ORDER BY 
    ld.disbursed_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    l.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    inst_avg.avg_balance,
    (lbs.principal_balance - inst_avg.avg_balance) AS excess_diff
FROM 
    loan_drawdown l
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            ca_inner.institution_id,
            AVG(lbs_inner.principal_balance) AS avg_balance
        FROM 
            loan_drawdown ld_inner
        JOIN 
            loan_balance_snapshot lbs_inner ON ld_inner.loan_id = lbs_inner.loan_id
        JOIN 
            credit_agreement ca_inner ON ld_inner.agreement_id = ca_inner.agreement_id
        GROUP BY 
            ca_inner.institution_id
    ) inst_avg ON ca.institution_id = inst_avg.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.principal_balance > (inst_avg.avg_balance * 2.0)
ORDER BY 
    excess_diff DESC;

WITH all_facilities AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM institution i
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.in!institution_name
),
non_related_facilities AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS non_related_amount
    FROM institution i
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    JOIN credit_participant cp ON ca.agreement_id = cp.agreement_id
    LEFT JOIN party_relation pr ON cp.party_id = pr.source_party_id 
        AND pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
        AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
    WHERE pr.relation_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
)
SELECT 
    af.institution_name,
    COALESCE(nrf.non_related_amount, 0.0) AS non_related_amount,
    af.total_amount,
    (COALESCE(nrf.non_related_amount, 0.0) * 1.0 / af.total_amount) AS ratio
FROM all_facilities af
LEFT JOIN non_related_facilities nrf ON af.institution_id = nrf.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance,
    cs.net_capital,
    (SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) AS concentration_ratio
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    )
    AND cs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM capital_snapshot cs2 
        WHERE cs2.institution_id = cs.institution_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, p.party_id, p.display_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING 
    (SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) > 0.10
ORDER BY 
    concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH industry_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.target_industry_code,
        AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL 
      AND ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.target_industry_code
)
SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ca.annual_interest_rate AS execution_rate,
    ia.avg_rate AS industry_avg_rate,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - ia.avg_rate) * 100.0 / ia.avg_rate, 2) AS markup_percentage
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_avg ia ON ca.target_industry_code = ia.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND ia.avg_rate > 0
  AND (ca.annual!annual_interest_rate - ia.avg_rate) * 1.0 / ia.avg_rate > 0.10
ORDER BY markup_percentage DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS excess_customer_count
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
        SELECT ca.agreement_id 
        FROM credit_agreement ca 
        WHERE ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM capital_snapshot 
        WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
    AND lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot 
        WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
    AND lbs.principal_balance > (cs.net_capital * 0.10)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    excess_customer_count DESC;

WITH group_exposures AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        eg.institution_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_balance
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON egm.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND eg.effective_to IS NULL
      AND egm.effective_to IS NULL
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id
),
capital_data AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE currency_code = 'CNY'
      AND as_of_date = (
          SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
          FROM capital_snapshot cs2 
          WHERE cs2.institution_id = capital_snapshot.institution_id
      )
)
SELECT 
    ge.exposure_group_id AS group_id,
    ge.group_name,
    ge.total_balance AS balance_sum,
    cd.net_capital,
    (ge.total_balance * 1.0 / cd.net_capital) AS concentration_ratio
FROM group_exposures ge
JOIN capital_data cd ON ge.institution_id = cd.institution_id
WHERE (ge.total_balance * 1.0 / cd.net_capital) > 0.10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.maturity_on,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.status,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = '已到期'
    AND ld.status = '正常'
ORDER BY 
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_between
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    payment_event pe ON ld.disbursement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
WHERE 
    pe.status = 'SETTLED'
    AND julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) <= 7
    AND julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) >= 0
ORDER BY 
    days_between ASC,
    pe.amount DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH LoanBalances AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        ca.obligor_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM institution i
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, ca.obligor_party_id
),
CapitalNet AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        MAX(net_capital) AS max_net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
Ratios AS (
    SELECT 
        lb.institution_id,
        lb.institution_name,
        lb.obligor_party_id,
        p.display_name AS customer_name,
        (lb.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / cn.max_net_capital) AS ratio
    FROM LoanBalances lb
    JOIN CapitalNet cn ON lb.institution_id = cn.institution_id
    JOIN party p ON lb.obligor_party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE cn.max_net_capital > 0
),
RankedRatios AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_name,
        customer_name,
        ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY institution_name ORDER BY ratio DESC) AS rn
    FROM Ratios
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    customer_name,
    ratio
FROM RankedRatios
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    loan_id, 
    principal_balance, 
    NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY i.institution_id ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile
FROM 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot 
        WHERE loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    )
ORDER BY 
    quartile ASC, 
    principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    i.institution_name,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / SUM(lbs.principal_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.institution_id) * 100.0, 2) AS ratio_percent
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
ORDER BY 
    i.institution_name ASC,
    ratio_percent DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    ld.status,
