-- 修正后的 JOIN 逻辑
FROM 
    service_operator so
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN 
    party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    so.operator_kind = '信贷经办员'
GROUP BY 
    so.operator_id, p.display_name, so.authority_level
ORDER BY 
    self_loan_contract_count DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS staff_name,
    ld.loan_id AS loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS disbursed_amount,
    ld.disbursed_on AS disbursed_on
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE 
    ah.holder_role = 'OWNER'
    AND ah.effective_to IS NULL
ORDER BY 
    ld.disbursed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    pp.annual_income AS annual_income,
    SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) AS total_repayment,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS repayment_to_income_ratio
FROM 
    repayment_schedule rs
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN 
    party_type_catalog ptc ON p.party_type = ptc.party_type
WHERE 
    ptc.name_zh = '个人'
    AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
    AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
ORDER BY 
    repayment_to_income_ratio DESC,
    p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT 
    lpc.product_name_zh AS product_category_name,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(lbs.overdue_principal, 0)) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    repayment_schedule rs
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_product_catalog lpc ON ca.product_family = lpc.product_code
LEFT JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
WHERE 
    rs.status != 'PAID' 
    AND rs.due_date < DATE('now')
GROUP BY 
    lpc.product_code, lpc.product_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND td.maturity_on <= date('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_90_days_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on > date('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_90_days_count
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    expired_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ah.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM 
    organization_unit ou
JOIN 
    account acc ON ou.org_unit_id = acc.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON acc.account_id = ah.account_id
WHERE 
    acc.account_kind = 'JOINT'
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_count,
    SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON ca.managing_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE 
    lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    SUM(rs.principal_due) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE 
    rs.status != 'PAID' 
    AND rs.due_date < DATE('now')
GROUP BY 
    ld.loan_id
HAVING 
    SUM(rs.principal_due) > 120000000.0
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status != 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_installment_count,
    SUM(rs.interest_due) AS total_interest_due
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE 
    rs.status != 'PAID'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status != 'PA!D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30
ORDER BY 
    overdue_installment_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE 
    rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan!id) >= 240
ORDER BY 
    overdue_loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    loan_id, 
    installment_no, 
    principal_due, 
    interest_due
FROM 
    repayment_schedule
WHERE 
    paid_on IS NULL 
    AND due_date < DATE('now')
    AND principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY 
    principal_due DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    cs.net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS disbursed_to_capital_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON cf.facility_id = ca.facility_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING 
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > cs.net_capital
ORDER BY 
    disbursed_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id AS security_agreement_id,
    sa.secured_amount AS secured_amount_setting,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE 
    sa.security_type = '保证担保'
    AND gc.status = '有效'
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    cf.facility_id,
    cf.limit_amount,
    sc.name_zh AS status_name
FROM 
    credit_facility cf
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc ON cf.status = sc.status_code AND sc.entity = 'credit_facility'
WHERE 
    cf.facility_type = '循环授信额度'
ORDER BY 
    cf.limit_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_limit_amount
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, cf.facility_type
HAVING 
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY 
    total_limit_amount DESC;

SELECT facility_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM credit_facility
WHERE limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY facility_type
ORDER BY record_count DESC;

SELECT pmc.payment_mode_name_zh, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc ON ld.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY record_count DESC;

WITH ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        minimum_holding_days,
        actual_raise_amount,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS group_id
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = '在售'
),
group_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        group_id,
        COUNT(*) AS product_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN minimum_holding_days > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_min_holding_gt_zero
    FROM ranked_products
    GROUP BY group_id
)
SELECT 
    group_id,
    count_min_h!_holding_gt_zero AS product_count
FROM group_stats
WHERE count_min_holding_gt_zero BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY group_id ASC;

SELECT 
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    credit_facility cf
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON cf.facility_id = ca.facility_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE 
    cf.facility_type = '循环授信'
    AND ld.payment_mode = '受托支付'
GROUP BY 
    cf.facility_id
ORDER BY 
    total_credit_limit DESC;

SELECT 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS pending_count
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pi.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
WHERE 
    pi.status = '待执行'
GROUP BY 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    pending_count DESC;

SELECT 
    itc.name_zh AS instrument_type_name,
    sc.name_zh AS status_name
FROM 
    instrument_type_catalog itc
CROSS JOIN 
    status_catalog sc
WHERE 
    sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY 
    itc.name_zh, 
    sc.name!_zh;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id AS "营业单元编号",
    ou.unit_name AS "营业单元名称",
    COUNT(sm.staff_id) AS "信贷客户经理人数"
FROM 
    organization_unit ou
JOIN 
    staff_assignment sa ON ou.org_unit_id = sa.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON sa.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE 
    sa.role_code = 'CREDIT_MANAGER'
    AND sa.effective_to IS NULL
    AND sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    "信贷客户经理人数" DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    ds.overdue_principal
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE 
    ds.principal_overdue_days > 30
    AND cg.is_nonperforming = 0
ORDER BY 
    ds.principal_overdue_days DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS insufficient_provision_count
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown l ON l.agreement_id IN (
        SELECT ca.agreement_id 
        FROM credit_agreement ca 
        WHERE ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON l.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE 
    ps.provision_stage = '2'
    AND (ps.recognized_amount * 1.0 / NULLIF(ps.required_amount, 0)) < 0.5
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(l.loan_id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    insufficient_provision_count DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount THEN (p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) ELSE 0 END) AS provision_gap_total
FROM 
    provision_snapshot p
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown l ON p.loan_id = l.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    provision_gap_total DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.account_subtype,
    abs.balance_snapshot AS ledger_balance
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    account_balance_snapshot abs ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id AND ah.holder_role != 'PRIMARY'
WHERE 
    a.status = '久悬'
    AND a.account_kind = '储蓄'
    AND ah.account_holder_id IS NULL
ORDER BY 
    abs.balance_snapshot DESC;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'PERSON'
    AND pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY 
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 
    customer_count DESC,
    p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT 
    ma.asset_category_primary,
    COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM 
    managed_asset ma
JOIN 
    private_credit_profile pcp ON ma.asset_id = pcp.asset_id
WHERE 
    pcp.is_monitored_sector = 1
GROUP BY 
    ma.asset_category_primary
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY 
    asset_count DESC,
    ma.asset!_category_primary ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    pp.annual_income,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS debt_service_ratio
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON p.party_id = cf.obligor_party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'Individual'
    AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
    AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, pp.annual_income
HAVING 
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY 
    debt_service_ratio DESC,
    p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 1!0;

SELECT occupation_code, employment_sector, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM person_profile
WHERE occupation_code IS NOT NULL AND employment_sector IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY occupation_code, employment_sector
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, occupation_code ASC, employment_sector ASC;

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'DEBIT'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY card_count DESC, status ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id AS org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name AS org_unit_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account acc_from ON pe.from_account_id = acc_from.account_id
JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON acc_from.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN 
    party p ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
    AND pc.card_type = 'CREDIT_CARD'
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    total_amount DESC, ou.unit_name ASC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pc.card_id,
    pc.holder_party_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
    AND pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC,
    pe.payment_id ASC,
    pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS holder_id,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS cash_transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
    AND pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(pe.payment!payment_id) > 5
ORDER BY 
    cash_transaction_count DESC,
    total_amount DESC;

SELECT holder_party_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
GROUP BY holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY card_count DESC, holder_party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ct.name_zh AS card_type_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(pe.payment_id), 2) AS avg_single_amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id OR pe.to_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN 
    card_type_catalog ct ON pc.card_type = ct.card_type
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
    AND ct.card_type IN ('贷记卡', '借记卡')
GROUP BY 
    ct.card_type
ORDER BY 
    avg_single_amount DESC,
    ct.name_zh ASC;

SELECT 
    channel,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    AVG(amount) * 1.0 AS average_amount
FROM 
    payment_event
WHERE 
    status = 'SETTLED'
    AND is_cash = 0
GROUP BY 
    channel
HAVING 
    AVG(amount) * 1.0 > 11780000
ORDER BY 
    average_amount DESC,
    channel ASC;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    td.maturity_on,
    a.status
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
    AND td.maturity_on < date('now')
    AND a.status = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY 
    td.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    MAX(cv.valuation_amount) AS max_valuation_amount
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING 
    COUNT(cv.valuation_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    max_valuation_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS reference_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS distinct_security_count
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING 
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    reference_count DESC,
    ca.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_customer_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ca.agreement_id AS credit_agreement_id,
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS guaranteed_amount,
    ROUND(ld.total_disbursed_amount, 2) AS total_disbursed_amount
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            agreement_id, 
            SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount
        FROM 
            loan_drawdown
        WHERE 
            status != 'CLOSED' OR status IS NULL
        GROUP BY 
            agreement_id
    ) ld_sum ON ca.agreement_id = ld_sum.agreement_id
WHERE 
    gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND gc.effective_to IS NULL
    AND gc.guaranteed_amount > ld_sum.total_disbursed_amount
ORDER BY 
    gc.guaranteed_amount DESC,
    g.guarantor_party_id ASC,
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.borrower_party_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0) AS total_security_coverage,
    (ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0)) AS coverage_gap
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
LEFT JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND (so.status = 'ACTIVE' OR so.status IS NULL)
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING 
    (ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0)) > 0
ORDER BY 
    coverage_gap DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS insufficient_provision_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
WHERE 
    cg.is_nonperforming = 1
    AND cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
    AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    insufficient_pro!provision_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.borrower_party_id AS debtor_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance AS loan_balance,
    ca.contract_amount AS credit_limit,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS balance_multiple
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    lbs.principal_balance >= ca.contract_amount * 4.0
    AND lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot 
        WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
ORDER BY 
    balance_multiple DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS over_provision_count,
    SUM(ps.recognized_amount - ps.required_amount) AS total_over_provision_amount
FROM 
    provision_snapshot ps
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = rc.as_of_date
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    cg.is_nonperforming = 1
    AND ps.recognized_amount > ps.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    total_over_provision_amount DESC,
    i.institution!name ASC,
    cg.grade_name_zh ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id AS "抵押物编号",
    ca.asset_label AS "抵押物名称",
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'internal' THEN cv.valuation_amount END), 2) AS "内部评估最高价值",
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'external' THEN cv.valuation_amount END), 2) AS "外部评估最高价值",
    ROUND(
        MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind =! 'external' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) - 
        MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'external' THEN cv.valuation_amount END), 
    2) AS "低估差额"
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING 
    MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'internal' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) IS NOT NULL
    AND MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'external' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) IS NOT NULL
    AND MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'internal' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) > MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'external' THEN cv.valuation_amount END)
ORDER BY 
    "低估差额" DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    cv.valuation_amount AS latest_valuation,
    SUM(cl.pledged_amount) AS total_pledged_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(cl.pledged_amount) - cv.valuation_amount, 2) AS coverage_gap
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
JOIN 
    collateral_valuation cv ON ca.coll!collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            collateral_id, 
            MAX(valued_on) AS max_valued_on
        FROM 
            collateral_valuation
        GROUP BY 
            collateral_id
    ) latest_cv ON cv.collateral_id = latest_cv.collateral_id AND cv.valued_on = latest_cv.max_valued_on
WHERE 
    cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, cv.valuation_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(cl.pledged_amount) > cv.valuation_amount
ORDER BY 
    coverage_gap DESC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS "保证人编号",
    p.display_name AS "保证人名称",
    ROUND(SUM(l.contract_amount), 2) AS "自身借款金额合计",
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS "对外保证金额合计"
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN 
    party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            cp.party_id,
            cd.agreement_id,
            cd.contract_amount
        FROM 
            credit_participant cp
        JOIN 
            credit_agreement cd ON cp.agreement_id = cd.agreement_id
        WHERE 
            cp.participant_role = 'BORROWER'
            AND cd.status = 'ACTIVE'
    ) l ON ca.agreement_id = l.agreement_id AND gc.guarantor_party_id = l.party_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            cp.party_id,
            cd.agreement_id,
            cd.contract_amount
        FROM 
            credit_participant cp
!
JOIN 
    credit_agreement cd ON cp.agreement_id = cd.agreement_id
        WHERE 
            cp.participant_role = 'BORROWER'
            AND cd.status = 'ACTIVE'
    ) own_borrow ON gc.guarantor_party_id = own_borrow.party_id
WHERE 
    gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND gc.effective_to IS NULL
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND sa.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > SUM(own_borrow.contract_amount)
ORDER BY 
    "对外保证金额合计" DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id AS security_contract_id,
    ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS secured_obligation_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE 
    sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.g!guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    pp.is_public_official = 1
    AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY 
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 
    customer_count DESC,
    p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    egtc.name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM 
    exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    exposure_group_type_catalog egtc ON eg.group_type = egtc.group_type
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_name,
    egtc.name_zh
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY 
    member_count DESC;

SELECT 
    egm.party_id AS member_customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM 
    exposure_group_member egm
JOIN 
    party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY 
    egm.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    group_count DESC, 
    egm.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS relation_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS loan_contract_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id OR p.party_id = pr.target_party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    relation_count DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id OR p.party_id = pr.target_party_id
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type = '影子股东'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    group_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_src.agreement_id) AS source_loan_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_tgt.agreement_id) AS target_loan_count
FROM 
    party_relation pr
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca_src ON pr.source_party_id = ca_src.borrower_party_id AND ca_src.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca_tgt ON pr.target_party_id = ca_tgt.borrower_party_id AND ca_tgt.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type = 'RELATED_PARTY'
    AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    pr.relation_id, pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id
ORDER BY 
    (COUNT(DISTINCT ca_src.agreement_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT ca_tgt.agreement_id)) DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ca.collateral_type
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
LEFT JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
    AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND (cl.effective_to IS NULL OR cl.effective_to > datetime('now'))
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cl.collateral_link_id IS NULL
ORDER BY 
    ca.collateral_id ASC;

WITH guarantor_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        p.party_id AS guarantor_id,
        p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
        SUM(COALESCE(gc.guaranteed_amount, 0)) AS total_guarantee_amount
    FROM party p
    JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE' 
      AND (gc.effective_to IS NULL OR gc.effective_to > DATE('now'))
    GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
),
borrower_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        p.party_id AS borrower_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, 0)) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM party p
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    )
    GROUP BY p.party_id
)
SELECT 
    ge.guarantor_id,
    ge.guarantor_name,
    ROUND(ge.total_guarantee_amount, 2) AS total_guarantee_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(be.total_loan_balance, 0), 2) AS own_loan_amount,
    ROUND(ge.total_guarantee_amount - COALESCE(be.total_loan_balance, 0), 2) AS excess_guarantee_amount
FROM guarantor_exposure ge
LEFT JOIN borrower_exposure be ON ge.guarantor_id = be.borrower_id
WHERE ge.total_guarantee_amount > COALESCE(be.total_loan_balance, 0)
ORDER BY excess_guarantee_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    gc.guaranteed_amount,
    gc.status
FROM 
    guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN 
    party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    gc.status = 'ACTIVE' 
    AND gc.effective_to IS NULL
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM credit_agreement ca
        JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
        JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
        WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
          AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
    )
ORDER BY 
    gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, 
    p.party_id ASC;

WITH RECURSIVE asset_chain AS (
    SELECT 
        wp.product_id,
        wp.product_name,
        pa.asset_id,
        pa.obligor_party_id,
        pa.asset_name,
        1 as depth
    FROM wealth_product wp
    JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
    JOIN managed_asset pa ON phs.asset_id = pa.asset_id
    WHERE phs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM product_holding_snapshot WHERE product_id = wp.product_id)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        ac.product_id,
        ac.product_name,
        pa.asset_id,
        pa.obligor_party_id,
        pa.asset_name,
        ac.depth + 1
    FROM asset_chain ac
    JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON ac.asset_id = phs.product_id 
    JOIN managed_asset pa ON phs.asset_id = pa.asset_id
    WHERE phs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM product_holding!_snapshot WHERE product_id = ac.product_id AND asset_id = ac.asset_id)
),
final_holdings AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        product_name,
        asset_id,
        asset_name,
        obligor_party_id
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            product_id,
            product_name,
            asset_id,
            asset_name,
            obligor_party_id,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, asset_id ORDER BY depth DESC) as rn
        FROM asset_chain
        WHERE obligor_party_id IS NOT NULL
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
overdue_borrowers AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        p.party_id as obligor_party_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(lbs.overdue_principal, 0)) as total_overdue_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN party p ON ld.borrower_party_id = p.party_id -- Assuming loan_drawdown has borrower or link to party via agreement
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
      AND lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id)
      AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
    GROUP BY ld.loan_id, p.party_id
),
aggregated_overdue AS (
    SELECT 
        obligor_party_id,
        SUM(total_overdue_principal) as total_overdue_sum
    FROM overdue_borrowers
    GROUP BY obligor_party_id
)
SELECT 
    fh.product_name,
    fh.asset_name,
    fh.obligor_party_id,
    ao.total_overdue_sum
FROM final_holdings fh
JOIN aggregated_overdue ao ON fh.obligor_party_id = ao.obligor_party_id
JOIN wealth_product wp ON fh.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN institution inst ON wp.issuer_institution_id = inst.institution_id
-- Implicitly checking that the obligor is a borrower of the same institution via the overdue records derived from that institution's loans
ORDER BY fh.product_name ASC, ao.total_overdue_sum DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_type AS 担保方式，
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.security_id) AS 担保合同笔数，
    ROUND(SUM(so.covered_amount), 2) AS 被担保金额合计
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE 
    sa.status = 'EFFECTIVE' 
    AND ca.status = 'EFFECTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_type
ORDER BY 
    被担保金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
LEFT JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND so.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) > 0 
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    exposure_group eg ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON egm.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id AND ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) AS total_inversion_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS inversion_position_count
FROM 
    product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN 
    wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
WHERE 
    phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING 
    SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY 
    total_inversion_amount DESC,
    wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    SUM(lds.principal_balance) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN 
    party issuer_party ON ma.issuer_party_id = issuer_party.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON issuer_party.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lds ON ld.loan_id = lds.loan_id
WHERE 
    phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
    AND wp.issuer_institution_id = ca.institution_id
    AND lds.overdue_principal > 0
    AND lds.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot 
        WHERE loan_id = lds.loan_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset!_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    ma.asset_id,
    issuer_party.party_id
ORDER BY 
    phs.lookthrough_depth DESC,
    phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_priority_valid_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_ratio_count
FROM 
    collateral_link cl
JOIN 
    collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE 
    cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND cl.lien_priority = 1
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    high_ratio_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    fs.total_assets,
    fs.total_liabilities,
    fs.net_assets,
    fs.annual_revenue
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = ('PTY-' || i.institution_id)
ORDER BY 
    fs.!annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 4) AS debt_to_asset_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE 
    fs.total_assets IS NOT NULL 
    AND fs.total_assets != 0
ORDER BY 
    debt_to_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.tier1_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS tier1_ratio
FROM 
    capital_snapshot cs
JOIN 
    institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.risk_weighted_assets IS NOT NULL 
    AND cs.risk_weighted_assets != 0
    AND cs.tier1_capital IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    tier1_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.net_assets * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS capital_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    fs.annual_revenue,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / total_sum.total_revenue * 100, 2) AS revenue_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
CROSS JOIN 
    (SELECT SUM(fs_sub.annual_revenue) AS total_revenue
     FROM financial_snapshot fs_sub
     JOIN institution i_sub ON i_sub.institution_id = substr(fs_sub.party_id, 5)
     WHERE fs_sub.annual_revenue IS NOT NULL
    ) AS total_sum
WHERE 
    fs.annual_revenue IS NOT NULL
    AND (fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / total_sum.total_revenue) > 0.15
ORDER BY 
    revenue_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    COUNT(*) AS mismatch_count
FROM 
    managed_asset ma
JOIN 
    institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL 
    AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL 
    AND ma.internal_rating != ma.external_rating
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    mismatch_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM 
    product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE 
    phs.investment_path LIKE '%穿透%' OR phs.lookthrough_depth > 0
GROUP BY 
    ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY 
    total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS account_count,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN 
    term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE 
    a.account_kind = '定期存款' OR a.account_subtype = '定期存款'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_principal DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count
FROM institution i
JOIN account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 0.03
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM 
    service_operator so
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE 
    sm.employment_type = 'Fixed'
GROUP BY 
    so.authority_level
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY 
    operator_count DESC,
   !so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30'
    AND td.maturity_on <= date('2026-06-30', '+30 days')
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) AS under_provision_total,
    fs.net_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets * 100, 2) AS under_provision_ratio_pct
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON 1=1
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot p ON ld.loan_id = p.loan_id
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON ('PTY-' || i.institution_id) = fs.party_id
WHERE 
    p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets
HAVING 
    SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY 
    under_provision_ratio_pct DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT 
    cg.grade_name_zh AS risk_classification_name,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM 
    risk_classification rc
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE 
    rc.classification_basis = 'manual'
    AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY 
    cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC,
    risk_classification_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS npl_loan_count,
    SUM(ls.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON i.institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM credit_agreement ca JOIN loan_drawdown l ON ca.agreement_id = l.agreement_id WHERE l.loan_id = ld.loan_id LIMIT 1)
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot ls ON ld.loan_id = ls.loan_id
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON ('PTY-' || i.institution_id) = fs.party_id
WHERE 
    ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
    AND ls.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id)
    AND ds.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM delinquency_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id)
    AND fs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM financial_snapshot WHERE party_id = 'PTY-' || i.in!institution_id)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id
HAVING 
    SUM(ls.overdue_principal) > (fs.annual_revenue * 0.5)
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets * 100, 2) AS loan_to_rwa_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.in!institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    ld.status != 'CLOSED'
    AND lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    )
    AND cs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM capital_snapshot cs2 
        WHERE cs2.institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY 
    loan_to_rwa_ratio DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.payment_mode,
    COUNT(*) AS instruction_count
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'PENDING'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    pi.payment_mode
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 45
ORDER BY 
    instruction_count DESC,
    pi.payment_mode ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS exception_count,
    SUM(p.amount_value) AS exception_amount,
    cs.net_capital,
    fs.total_assets,
    (SUM(p.amount_value) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital * 100.0) AS ratio_to_net_capital
FROM 
    prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 p
JOIN 
    institution i ON p.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.in!institution_id
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = ('PTY-' || i.institution_id)
WHERE 
    p.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital, fs.total_assets
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 8
ORDER BY 
    ratio_to_net_capital DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rse.record_id) AS overdue_report_count,
    AVG(ls.principal_balance) AS avg_loan_balance,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ps.loan_id) AS under_provisioned_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS provision_gap_amount
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    regulatory_submission_event_v3 rse ON i.institution_id = rse.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON i.institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM credit_agreement ca JOIN loan_drawdown ldd ON ca.agreement_id = ldd.agreement_id WHERE ldd.loan_id = ld.loan_id LIMIT 1)
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot ls ON ld.loan_id = ls.loan_id
WHERE 
    rse.status_code != 'COMPLETED'
    AND rse.event_code LIKE '%OVERDUE%'
    AND ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT rse.record_id) >= 25
ORDER BY 
    provision_gap_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(cf.facility_id) AS total_credit_facilities,
    ROUND(SUM(gcr.amount_value), 2) AS governance_exception_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(gcr.ratio_value) * 1.0, 4) AS avg_observed_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
LEFT JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
LEFT JOIN 
    governance_control_record_v3 gcr ON i.institution_id = gcr.institution_id AND gcr.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.in!institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 END) >= 5
ORDER BY 
    governance_exception_amount DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS target_party_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS relation_type_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_non_related_party_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE 
    p.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    target_party_count DESC,
   !relation_type_count DESC,
    customer_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS card_holder_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ore.exception_flag = 1 THEN ore.amount_value ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS operational_risk_exception_amount,
    COUNT(ore.record_id) AS operational_risk_valid_count
FROM 
    institution i
LEFT JOIN 
    account a ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN 
    operational_risk_event_v3 ore ON ore.institution_id = i.institution_id AND ore.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(ore.record_id) >= 43
ORDER BY 
    operational_r!isk_exception_amount DESC, 
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN wp.product_id END) AS active_product_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0.0 END) AS total_actual_raise,
    COUNT(pse.sale_event_id) AS behavior_record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pse.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(pse.sale_event_id), 4) AS avg_exception_ratio
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    institution i ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    product_sale_event pse ON wp.product_id = pse.product_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN pse.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    total_actual_raise DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ma.status = '有效' THEN ma.asset_id END) AS valid_custody_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ma.status = '有效' AND ma.is_liability = 1 THEN ma.issued_amount ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS abnormal_amount_sum
FROM 
    managed_asset ma
JOIN 
    institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ma.status = '有效'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ma.status = '有效' AND ma.is_liability = 1 THEN 1 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    total_issued_amount DESC, 
    i.institution_name ASC;
